ideas_considered.picked: Freeze train-mean θ_K and θ_M (concentrated across bimodal s1/γ families) then v4 center-4 SPSA of (γ,s1,s2,s3) by projecting those two coordinates in the energy map. Tests whether PR119's unsigned-all collapse is only from averaging the bimodal slice, without two-template min-selection and without dropping per-instance SPSA.
ideas_considered.held: More aggressive matched-dim freeze of θ_K, θ_M, s2, s3 with SPSA of only (γ,s1). s3 does not concentrate (std ~0.19 on recent trains), so that freeze is not justified yet. Held unless this geom-2 freeze first beats QAOA and sits near the independent Nov3 ceiling.

ft_source.recipe: unmodified v4 center-4 run_equal4; geometry freeze is an energy-map projection, not an alloc.py patch

hypothesis.one_sentence: At N=18 L=1, per-instance v4 SPSA of original Nov3 with θ_K and θ_M frozen at the train mean, minus independently fitted QAOA p=1, has mean ΔE CI entirely <0 on 8 unread test instances.
hypothesis.not: Not two-template. Not unsigned-mean of the full vector. Not sign-aligned as primary. Not L2/L3. Not a GR patch. Not adoption. Does not replace per-instance SPSA unless the transfer gap vs independent Nov3 also has CI containing 0, which is secondary and does not switch the primary. Does not reopen PR119.

split_documented_before_fits.rule: Stage A fits independent Nov3 on train only. Freeze coordinate-wise mean of θ_K and θ_M from those 8 train vectors before any test SPSA. Stage B: independent Nov3 and QAOA on test, plus geom Nov3 SPSA with those two coordinates overwritten in every energy call. Primary vs secondary not chosen on test.
